notes:
v0.3.34 - the shutdown icon, and less to read on Local models

FIXED: the power emblem on "Shut down everything" was not centred, and it was
never going to be. It was a text character (U+23FB) that the app's font has no
glyph for, so Windows quietly substituted another font - which decided its
size, weight and position, and on a PC without that font would have shown an
empty box instead of an icon. It is drawn now, so it sits in the middle on
every machine.

CHANGED: the Local models screen said too much. Roughly half the text is gone.
Nothing was dropped that the screen needs to be honest abo
